rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for routine paperwork, and it can also describe paperwork as burdensome work without specifically stressing red tape.

example.english: This paperwork is really a hassle.
example.traditional: 呢啲文書工作真係幾煩㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 man4 syu1 gung1 zok3 zan1 hai6 gei2 faan4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when “paperwork” means the written documents or forms themselves rather than the work of handling them.

example.english: Have you filled out the paperwork yet?
example.jyutping: nei5 tin4 hou2 di1 man4 gin2 mei6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when the paperwork refers to administrative procedures imposed by an organization, especially when they feel excessive or burdensome.

example.english: Applying for this subsidy involves a lot of paperwork.
example.traditional: 申請呢項資助要經好多行政手續。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 ne1 hong6 zi1 zo6 jiu3 ging1 hou2 do1 hang4 zing3 sau2 zuk6
